title: Composite transition localization for a tower of rings
statement: Let $A\to B\to C$ and $A^{\prime}\to B^{\prime}\to C^{\prime}$ be towers of commutative rings, with the composite algebra structures, and let $r:A\to A^{\prime}$, $s:B\to B^{\prime}$, $t:C\to C^{\prime}$ be ring maps. Assume there is a ring map $\phi_B:B\otimes_A A^{\prime}\to B^{\prime}$ sending $b\otimes a$ to $s(b)a$, which is a localization at a submonoid $U_B$, and a ring map $\phi_C:C\otimes_B B^{\prime}\to C^{\prime}$ sending $c\otimes b$ to $t(c)b$, which is a localization at a submonoid $U_C$. Here a localization sends the submonoid to units, every element of the target is a fraction, and equality of images is killed by multiplication by some submonoid element, as in [lem-weil-pbc-localization-of-localization]. Then there are a submonoid $U$ of $C\otimes_A A^{\prime}$ and a ring map $f:C\otimes_A A^{\prime}\to C^{\prime}$ sending $c\otimes a$ to $t(c)a$ such that $f$ is a localization at $U$.

proof.text: Put P = B tensor over A A′. The pure-tensor formula for φ_B makes it B-linear for s. Base-change the localization P → B′ along C tensor over B P. The resulting map C tensor over B P → C tensor over B B′ is a localization at the image of U_B.

proof.text: Compose with the given localization φ_C. Localization of a localization is a localization. On c tensor a′ the composite is φ_C(c tensor φ_B(1 tensor a′)) = t(c) times the image of a′ in C′; the scalar-tower identity supplies the last equality.

theorem tensorLocalization_tower_transition
    (A B C A' B' C' : Type u)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [CommRing A'] [CommRing B'] [CommRing C']
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
    [Algebra A' B'] [Algebra B' C'] [Algebra A' C'] [IsScalarTower A' B' C']
    (r : A →+* A') (s : B →+* B') (t : C →+* C')
    (hB :
      letI := r.toAlgebra
      ∃ φ : B ⊗[A] A' →+* B',
        (∀ (b : B) (a : A'), φ (b ⊗ₜ[A] a) = s b * algebraMap A' B' a) ∧
        (letI := φ.toAlgebra; ∃ U : Submonoid (B ⊗[A] A'), IsLocalization U B'))
    (hC :
      letI := s.toAlgebra
      ∃ φ : C ⊗[B] B' →+* C',
        (∀ (c : C) (b : B'), φ (c ⊗ₜ[B] b) = t c * algebraMap B' C' b) ∧
        (letI := φ.toAlgebra; ∃ U : Submonoid (C ⊗[B] B'), IsLocalization U C')) :
    letI := r.toAlgebra
    ∃ (f : C ⊗[A] A' →+* C') (U : Submonoid (C ⊗[A] A')),
      (∀ (c : C) (a : A'), f (c ⊗ₜ[A] a) = t c * algebraMap A' C' a) ∧
      (letI := f.toAlgebra; IsLocalization U C')
